intervention: Create a fresh0700run directory, save write-once0600generation-input.json and generation-result.json before inference/validation respectively, and append fsynced0600generation-events.ndjson independently of console audit. Emit full-source snapshot before inference. Clear per-attempt context on every exit.
privacy_and_recovery: Private state already ignored by Git and Docker; no new environment variable, source-repository write or public catalog output.

Inputs/results write once; an existing run-name collision fails before inference rather than overwriting prior evidence.
Transport events retain original UTF8body or invalid-UTF8base64/checksum before rejection.
Input persistence failure stops before inference; partial files after an external interruption must be validated, not assumed complete.
No-op, human-edit and pending-recovery boundaries remain before attempt creation.
Retained data is unapproved research evidence, not training gold or neural learning; no automatic purge.
limits: Per-run retention applies to normal process/run workflows; direct ad hoc infer calls without an attempt context still need their explicit research harness.
This preserves supplied source and model drafts; it does not make those drafts factually correct.
